4. Garage door 16'-0" × 7'-0" recessed 5'-0" behind the front wall of the dwelling —

windows per 2024 IRC (GA 2026) R310 — VERIFY net clear opening at unit selection.

17'-0" × 26'-10" front wing + 38'-0" × 25'-0" rear block = 1,406 SF conditioned (−2.6%);
overall body 38'-0" × 51'-10" plus porch and patio.

20-ft rear buffer easement on a 100-ft lot (15 + 6 + 5 + 21'-10" + 25 + 8 = 80'-10").
VERIFY with Planning staff whether an at-grade uncovered slab is a buffer encroachment;
otherwise hold the patio at 7 ft.
